answer.explanation: The live configuration of CrudApiFunction has MemorySize=128 and Timeout=3, while the SAM template declares MemorySize: 256 and Timeout: 10. The function was last modified at 01:14:47, two seconds before the window opened, so the drift was introduced just before the window. The other three functions match the template. Within the window, the function logs show Max Memory Used around 90 MB, with no timeouts or errors and durations under 400 ms, so the drift has not yet caused visible failures. Environment variables, reserved concurrency and the execution role match the template. The drift is still a live-versus-intended configuration anomaly, most likely a manual or out-of-band change.
